properties.displayName: Demo environment - audit virtual machines without an auto-shutdown schedule
properties.description: Audits virtual machines that do not have an enabled auto-shutdown schedule (Microsoft.DevTestLab/schedules resource named 'shutdown-computevm-<vmName>') configured. Used to identify VMs that are not covered by the demo environment's automatic shutdown/idle lifecycle control. Implements TR-004 (Automatic shutdown and idle lifecycle control).

metadata.description: Enable or disable execution of this policy
